summary: Flathead County, MT crow's nest and camp dated 1929, abandoned 1938; firelookout.com says the crow's nest is still there, undated; FFLA lists Abandoned.

facts.status_note: FFLA lists it as Abandoned; firelookout.com says the crow's nest is 'still there' with no date. Neither source calls it gone.

events.note: Crow's nest and camp, per firelookout.com

evidence.supports: 11 miles southwest of Whitefish, Flathead County
crow's nest described as still there, undated
type crowsnest; coordinates 48.33975 north, 114.55289 west; status Abandoned

corrections.why: The FFLA Montana list gives the status Abandoned, not Gone.

corrections.proposed: firelookout.com gives no status word; it says 'crows nest (still there)' with no date
corrections.why: The record turned the undated 'still there' remark into a standing status, which the page does not state.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says the crow's nest is still there but does not date the remark. The FFLA list gives Abandoned. The story reports both and calls the site neither standing nor gone.

notes_for_editor: Only the firelookout.com page and one FFLA row exist. Two WebSearch calls: one returned the same firelookout.com page, the other returned nothing. The record's firelookout_com standing value is not on the page, which says only crows nest (still there), undated, so a dated visit or report is needed before any status is set. A Flathead NF history PDF (Trails of the Past) mentions a Mountain Meadow on Grave Creek only as a trapper's cabin site, a different place, so it is not cited. Photos are already in the record; none new. Access and visit are left out because no source covers them.
